title: Motie van het lid Beckerman over een bevoegde instantie aanwijzen om ook deepfakeporno en andere onrechtmatige seksuele beelden offline te halen

reading.body:
Deepfake pornographic videos featuring the faces of Dutch public figures were created and hosted on a platform accessible to millions of users. The victims included television presenters, politicians, athletes, and members of the royal family. The system that generated and distributed these videos operated without intervention to verify consent or prevent non-consensual sexual imagery.

This is a failure of impersonation at scale. A generative system created fake sexual content impersonating real named individuals and made it available online. The deployment lacked any mechanism to prevent the creation of non-consensual intimate imagery, which is classified as illegal in the jurisdiction where the victims live.

It is not established how the videos were created, what platform hosted them, or what technical measures might have prevented or caught this before public discovery.

summary:
Several well-known Dutch women are considering legal action after discovering manipulated pornographic videos featuring their faces on an online platform that receives 13 million monthly visitors. The videos include Dutch performers, television presenters, Olympic athletes, current and former government officials, mayors, and members of the royal family. Justice Minister Yesilgöz called the videos disgusting and urged victims to file reports. Managers and representatives of various victims have confirmed they have filed complaints or are exploring legal options.

Deepfake pornography is classified as revenge porn and is therefore illegal. Lawyers advise victims to file reports, which may allow prosecutors to shut down websites hosting such material. Additional options include launching group claims, filing complaints with data protection authorities, or contacting hosting companies. This follows a previous case involving TV presenter Welmoed Sijtsma, who made a documentary about her experience after a 39-year-old man from Amersfoort received a conditional sentence of 180 hours for creating fake pornographic videos of her.
title_en: Motion by member Beckerman on designating a competent authority to also remove deepfake pornography and other unlawful sexual images offline
